subject: Remove stream loads and slightly improve avx512 seed generation
perf_evidence: Commit removes streaming-load hints that hinder instruction fusion and changes AVX512 secret initialization.
change_summary: Removes non-temporal load metadata from AVX512 seed generation and changes SIMD seed arithmetic.

units.name: public XXH3 fixed 256/320-byte AVX2 paths
units.evidence: Five AVX2 public targets and the raw custom-secret initializer pass Alive2 in both directions.

units.name: exact AVX512 nontemporal-load IR, public seeded and raw initializer paths
units.evidence: Alive2 rejects the old-side nontemporal metadata for the seeded AVX512 public target; the raw AVX512 initializer has the same translation failure.

units.name: AVX512 seed generation after removing unsupported nontemporal metadata from old IR
units.precondition: old-side !nontemporal load metadata removed for Alive2 translation
units.evidence: All five AVX512 public targets pass both directions after the old-side metadata is removed; the corresponding raw initializer also passes in r_raw_avx512_nt.

notes: The normalized rerun is conditional evidence about computations after deleting exactly the old !nontemporal annotations; it is not counted as a direct Alive2 proof of the exact performance-relevant LLVM IR. Four other AVX512 public cases pass without normalization.
